evals.prompt: Outline an architecture review deck for our proposed move to event-driven order processing — the audience is staff engineers plus one VP.
assertions: Every slide title asserts a claim rather than labelling a topic ('We can ship this in two quarters', not 'Timeline')
No single slide mixes high-level overview with deep technical detail — where both are needed it becomes two slides
Speaker notes carry the narrative while the slide carries the evidence; the script is not dumped onto the slide
The output is a structured outline the user can paste into their own tool — no .pptx file is produced
Slide count and depth are matched to the stated audience
